item.text:
**Bottom line:** weakly positive on planning and some tech/admin capacity, but overall negative. The pro evidence is mostly top-down, state-directed, or sandboxed. The stronger record is secrecy, war extraction, and growth concentrated in military production rather than broad productivity foundations.

| Direction | Title | Publisher | Date | Recoverable URL | Claim-level summary | IDs |
|---|---|---:|---|---|---|---|
| Weak pro | Executive Order on Russia's development goals through 2030 and for the future until 2036 | President of Russia | 2024-05-07 | https://en.special.kremlin.ru/events/president/news/73986 | Sets long-run goals for infrastructure for life, efficient transport, a data economy, and digital transformation of the state. It also orders a unified plan and a comprehensive transport/energy/telecom/social infrastructure plan, plus priority budget allocations. This is real planning, but still only a plan. | 5B.6; also 5B.1, 5B.4 |
| Weak pro | Указ Президента Российской Федерации от 15.02.2024 г. № 124 | President of Russia | 2024-02-15 | https://www.kremlin.ru/acts/bank/50326/print | Amends the AI strategy to push supercomputers, cloud access, data sets, open AI libraries, resilient networks, civil-servant training, and better regulatory support for AI. This is the clearest technology and admin-capacity investment I found. | 5B.6; also 5B.4 |
| Weak pro | Putin signed law on external settlements in cryptocurrency | TASS | 2024-08-08 | https://tass.ru/ekonomika/21561653 | Creates an experimental legal regime for digital innovation and crypto settlements under central-bank control. That is a narrow pro-innovation move, but tightly supervised rather than broadly liberalizing. | 5B.6; also 5B.4 |
| Weak pro | Russia: Nations in Transit 2024 Country Report | Freedom House | 2024 | https://freedomhouse.org/country/russia/nations-transit/2024 | Notes a June 2024 directive to improve municipal finances by changing tax-revenue allocation methods. That is a small administrative-capacity adjustment, though the same report says local autonomy remained weak. | 5B.6; also 5B.4 |
| Against | Putin lets economically significant entities limit information disclosures | Reuters | 2024-01-29 | https://uk.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/putin-lets-economically-significant-entities-limit-information-disclosures-3315001 | Widening secrecy privileges reduces transparency and external scrutiny. That weakens predictable regulation and investor confidence, both of which matter for productivity growth. | 5B.6; also 5B.4, 5B.5 |
| Against | Analysis-Russia's GDP boost from military spending belies wider economic woes | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-02-07 | https://www.investing.com/news/economy/analysisrussias-gdp-boost-on-military-spending-belies-wider-economic-woes-3295688 | Reuters said the growth rebound relied heavily on state-funded arms and ammunition production and masked wider problems. That is war-driven output, not broad investment in productivity foundations. | 5B.6; also 5B.1 |
| Against | Analysis-Russia braces for more tax rises to fund the Ukraine war | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-10-31 | https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/analysisrussia-braces-for-more-tax-rises-to-fund-the-ukraine-war-3693480 | More tax rises were needed to finance ballooning military spending. That points to extraction for war rather than durable investment in infrastructure, health, education, or predictable regulation. | 5B.6; also 5B.1, 5B.3 |
| Against | Russia: Freedom in the World 2024 Country Report | Freedom House | 2024 | https://freedomhouse.org/country/russia/freedom-world/2024 | Describes pervasive corruption, expropriation risk, state pressure on firms, and the distribution of economic assets to allies in return for loyalty. That undermines predictable rules and long-term productivity investment. | 5B.6; also 5B.4, 5B.5 |

**Assessment**
- The strongest pro evidence is forward-looking planning, not proven delivery.
- The strongest concrete investments are in AI/digital infrastructure and administrative control of experimentation.
- I did not find credible 2024 evidence of a major, broad-based push in education or health comparable to the scale of the war economy.
- The negative evidence is stronger: secrecy, corruption, state pressure on firms, and military-financed growth all weaken productivity foundations.

**Search gap**
- I did not find durable evidence of a broad, predictable reform package for education, health, physical infrastructure, or property/regulatory stability.
- The positive material is mostly state-led planning and controlled digital experimentation, not independent institutional strengthening.
